integrity: Analytic proof and standalone exact-rational check of 5615 supplementary assertions; prior-work comparisons distinguish the original Cohen germination criterion from the new fixed-moment ordering and robust endpoint; historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Independent-year scalar density-independent four-positive-yield seed bank; fixed known yield alphabet, fixed mean and variance, fixed survival positive and at most one and mean yield > survival; not calibrated to real field outcomes; does not extend automatically beyond four outcomes.
title: Four-yield skewness orders optimal germination and selects a moment-robust seed strategy
